analysis: User-selectable local green-cover what-if cooling scenario simulation
scenario_units: percentage-point increase in grid green-cover fraction
scenario_scope: Independent local grid-cell counterfactual. One selected grid changes while all other grids stay at their Step-28 baseline forecast.
feature_selection_handling: Only green-cover-dependent predictors that survived the frozen Step-21 93-feature selection are updated. Excluded engineered intermediates are computed internally only when required to rebuild a retained predictor.
scenario_lst_formula: baseline Step-28 predicted LST + local anomaly delta
cooling_benefit_formula: baseline Step-28 predicted LST - scenario predicted LST
scenario_recentering: Not performed because rows represent independent local interventions rather than a simultaneous citywide intervention.
annual_level_policy: Frozen Step-28 annual Kaduwela thermal level is unchanged.
interpretation_warning: Scenario results are modeled statistical sensitivity, not guaranteed physical cooling. Real-world outcomes depend on implementation conditions not represented in the model.
monotonicity_policy: No monotonic constraint is imposed. Non-monotonic LightGBM responses are retained and reported.
